title: Weekend port of a Python codebase to 165k lines of TypeScript with hundreds of agents
summary: Anthropic's Mike Krieger used Claude Code agents to migrate a Python codebase to TypeScript over a weekend, structured as phase gates, adversarial review rounds and a parity check that diffed every command's output against the original.
agent_role: Hundreds of agents translated code, ran adversarial reviews and parity diffs across eight phase gates; humans designed the process (rulebook, dependency maps, gates) and fixed the loop rather than the code.
outcome: Python codebase migrated to 165,000 lines of TypeScript over a weekend, verified by a final output-parity check against the Python original

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
